name: @xmrswap/monero-regtest
description: Regtest harness + prototype for the 2-of-2 joint-address XMR lock (derive, fund, verify by view key, sweep)

scripts.build:wasm: cd rust-sweep && cargo build --release --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cd .. && ${WASM_BINDGEN:-wasm-bindgen} --target web --out-dir browser/pkg rust-sweep/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/xmr_joint_sweep.wasm
scripts.test: node e2e.mjs && node edge-cases.mjs && node deposit-watch.mjs && node presplit-demo.mjs && node run-rust-sweep.mjs && node browser/run-browser-sweep.mjs
